research.title: Image Preprocessing for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned image normalization and patch extraction routines in NumPy following the group's preprocessing specification for surface defect images.
Ran prescribed classification experiments and inspected misclassified patches, documenting preprocessing inconsistencies and recurring confusion between texture variations and visible defects.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Processing
bullets: Updated inventory records from receiving paperwork, checked item descriptions against delivery documents, and flagged discrepancies for supervisor review.
Prepared routine order paperwork, organized delivery records, and coordinated missing documentation with staff before forwarding completed files for processing.

projects.title: Handwritten Character Classification with Linear Baselines
bullets: Implemented a baseline handwritten character classifier using flattened grayscale images and logistic regression in scikit-learn, with separate training and evaluation partitions.
Compared raw and standardized pixel features under a fixed evaluation split, examining confusion matrices and representative errors involving visually similar characters.
